title: Penalty Shootout
desc: Take part in a best-of-five penalty shootout against the AI, both scoring and keeping goal.

title: Archery
desc: Loose ten arrows at a moving ring target in the wind and score fifteen points to win.

title: Mini Golf
desc: Putt through six hand-authored holes with bumpers, sand and walls against a par of nineteen.

title: Curling
desc: Slide stones with sweeping-assisted weight over three ends and count closest to the button against the AI.

title: Free Throw
desc: Sink twelve points from ten free throws using a timed power meter and real rim bounces.
